summary: No error message shown when the wrong password is entered at sign-in
description: When a wrong password is entered on the login page the user gets no error message at all. The page simply reloads. This seriously hurts the user experience.

summary: User is not signed out automatically once the session token expires
description: The user stays in an active session even after the JWT token has expired. This creates a security hole. Token expiry is never checked.

summary: Password reset link is still valid 24 hours later
description: The link in the password reset email should expire after 1 hour, but it stays active for 24 hours. This breaks the security policy.

summary: Two-factor authentication code is not sent over SMS
description: Users with 2FA enabled never receive the SMS verification code. The SMS gateway integration times out. Those users cannot sign in at all.

summary: Brute force protection does not work — unlimited sign-in attempts are possible
description: Rate limiting is disabled on the login endpoint. The account should lock after 5 failed attempts, but there is no limit of any kind.

summary: LDAP integration cannot authenticate usernames containing special characters
description: LDAP users whose username contains Turkish characters (ş, ç, ğ, ı, ö, ü) cannot sign in. There is an encoding problem.

summary: 3D Secure verification fails for credit card payments
description: The callback URL comes back wrong after the 3D Secure redirect, so the payment never completes. This affects every credit card transaction.

summary: Refund amount is calculated incorrectly — VAT is left out
description: When a product is returned, the amount refunded to the customer excludes VAT. Customers are being underpaid.

summary: Bank reference number is not stored for wire transfer payments
description: When a customer pays by wire transfer the bank reference number is never written to the database, which makes reconciliation impossible.

summary: Infinite scroll does not work on the product list page
description: Scrolling down on the product list page loads no further products. Only the first 20 are visible. The pagination API is never called.

summary: Menu button cannot be tapped in the mobile view
description: A z-index problem makes the hamburger menu button untappable in the responsive layout. Navigation is unusable below 768px.

summary: Form fields are unreadable while dark mode is on
description: With the dark theme active, the text colour and background colour of input fields are identical. Users cannot see what they are typing.

summary: Product quantity can be pushed below zero on the cart page
description: The decrease button lets the quantity in the cart drop below 0. Values like -1 and -2 are accepted. Input validation is missing.

summary: Date filter returns the wrong results in the order report
description: The date range filter in the reporting module converts between UTC and local time incorrectly. A range picked in Turkish local time is off by 3 hours.

summary: Excel export times out beyond 10,000 rows
description: Exporting a large report to Excel returns a 504 Gateway Timeout once it passes 10,000 rows. An asynchronous export mechanism is needed.

summary: Stock quantity hits a race condition with simultaneous orders
description: When two users add the last item to their cart at the same time, stock drops to -1. The database transaction isolation level is too weak.

summary: Stock quantity takes 30 minutes to update after a warehouse transfer
description: Stock data is not refreshed immediately after a transfer between warehouses. There is a cache invalidation problem, and data is 30 minutes stale.

summary: Push notifications are not shown on Android 14 devices
description: Push notifications are not displayed because of the new notification permission policy introduced in Android 14. The runtime permission has to be requested.

summary: Email notifications land in the spam folder
description: Order confirmation and shipping notification emails sent by the system land in the spam folder the vast majority of the time. The SPF and DKIM records are missing.

summary: Notification preferences are not saved — they reset on every sign-in
description: A user sets their notification preferences (email, SMS, push), but signing out and back in returns every preference to its default. These should be stored in the backend rather than in LocalStorage.
